name: Jezebel
source:
Daughter of Orcus, the demon lord of undeath, Princess Jezebel is a succubus hellbent on conquering the kingdom and make it the demons foothold on the material plane. Will she find a mortal champion to help her in her quest?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1806280/Leap_of_Love__Dark_Princesses/]Steam[/url]]
